intro.zh: 你的主课本。和 Roy 老师一章一章地学。每个新词都先解释。按 🔊 听，再按一次（或按 ⏹ 停止）就停下。

title.en: Science: Weather and Climate (book pages 219 to 230)
title.zh: 科学：天气和气候（课本第 219 到 230 页）

points.en: Soil is a mixture of rock pieces, minerals and organic matter. A mixture means different things mixed together.
points.zh: 土壤是岩石碎块、矿物和有机物的混合物。混合物就是不同的东西混在一起。

points.en: Weathering means rocks slowly breaking into smaller pieces. Weathering makes the rock and mineral bits in soil.
points.zh: 风化就是岩石慢慢碎成更小的块。风化产生了土壤里的岩石和矿物颗粒。

points.en: Water and air fill the small spaces between the soil pieces.
points.zh: 水和空气填满土壤颗粒之间的小空隙。

remember.en: soil = rock pieces + minerals + organic matter (+ water and air)
remember.zh: 土壤 = 岩石碎块 + 矿物 + 有机物（+ 水和空气）

quick.q: Is soil only made of rock?

why.en: Soil is a mixture: rock pieces, minerals, organic matter, water and air.
why.zh: 土壤是混合物：岩石碎块、矿物、有机物、水和空气。

points.en: Organic means made by living things, like leaves, twigs and dead animals.
points.zh: 有机的意思是由生物形成的，比如树叶、树枝和死去的动物。

points.en: Inorganic means NOT made by living things, like rock, minerals, water and air.
points.zh: 无机的意思是不是由生物形成的，比如岩石、矿物、水和空气。

points.en: Humus is the organic material in soil. Bacteria and fungi break down dead plants and animals, and that makes humus.
points.zh: 腐殖质是土壤里的有机物。细菌和真菌分解死去的植物和动物，就形成了腐殖质。

steps.en: bacteria and fungi break them down

remember.en: humus = organic material from decaying plants and animals
remember.zh: 腐殖质 = 腐烂的植物和动物形成的有机物

why.en: A leaf came from a living thing, so it is organic.
why.zh: 树叶来自生物，所以是有机的。

points.en: A horizon is one layer of soil. Soil is made of horizons, one on top of another.
points.zh: 土层就是土壤的一层。土壤由一层一层的土层叠起来组成。

points.en: It takes thousands of years for soil to become mature (fully grown). Mature soil has four horizons. Younger soil has fewer.
points.zh: 土壤要几千年才能变成熟。成熟的土壤有四层，年轻的土壤层数更少。

points.en: From top to bottom: O, A, B, C.
points.zh: 从上到下：O、A、B、C。

remember.en: O, A, B, C from top to bottom
remember.zh: 从上到下是 O、A、B、C

quick.q: Which layer is at the very TOP?

why.en: O is the leaf layer on top. C is weathered rock at the bottom.
why.zh: O 层是最上面的落叶层，C 层是最下面的风化岩石。

points.en: Draw a big box. Split it into 4 layers. Add grass on top.
points.zh: 画一个大方框，分成 4 层，上面画上草。

points.en: Colour them: dark brown, brown, orange-brown, grey. Draw leaves, roots, a worm and some rocks.
points.zh: 涂颜色：深棕、棕、橙棕、灰。画上树叶、根、一条蚯蚓和一些石头。

prompt.en: Draw the 4 soil layers and label each one.
prompt.zh: 画出 4 个土层，并给每一层写上标签。

points.en: Horizon O: mostly decaying leaves, twigs, and animal remains and wastes.
points.zh: O 层：主要是腐烂的树叶、树枝，以及动物的遗体和排泄物。

points.en: Horizon A (topsoil): loose soil rich in the organic material plants need, such as humus and nitrogen compounds.
points.zh: A 层（表土）：疏松的土壤，富含植物需要的有机物，比如腐殖质和含氮化合物。

points.en: Horizon B (subsoil): rich in minerals such as iron and aluminum compounds that rainwater washed down from Horizon A. It also has humus and clay, the tiniest soil particles.
points.zh: B 层（底土）：富含雨水从 A 层冲下来的矿物，比如铁和铝的化合物。也有腐殖质和黏土（最小的土壤颗粒）。

points.en: Horizon C: mostly pieces of weathered rock.
points.zh: C 层：主要是风化的岩石碎块。

remember.en: topsoil = A, subsoil = B
remember.zh: 表土 = A 层，底土 = B 层

why.en: Topsoil = A. Subsoil = B.
why.zh: 表土 = A 层，底土 = B 层。

canNow.en: I can now explain what soil is made of and name the four soil horizons.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以说出土壤由什么组成，并说出四个土层。

points.en: Weathering breaks rocks into small pieces. Sediment means small pieces of rock and soil that get carried away.
points.zh: 风化把岩石碎成小块。沉积物就是被带走的岩石和土壤小碎块。

points.en: Erosion: moving water, ice, wind or gravity carries the pieces away. Erosion takes land away in one place.
points.zh: 侵蚀：流水、冰、风或重力把碎块带走。侵蚀让一个地方的土地变少。

points.en: Deposition: the pieces are dropped in a new place. Deposition builds land in another place.
points.zh: 沉积：碎块被放到新的地方。沉积让另一个地方的土地变多。

remember.en: erosion takes away, deposition drops
remember.zh: 侵蚀是带走，沉积是放下

why.en: Erosion takes away. Deposition drops.
why.zh: 侵蚀是带走，沉积是放下。

points.en: Rainwater running off the land carries sediment and leaves a path called a gully.
points.zh: 雨水从地面流走时带走沉积物，留下一条小沟，叫冲沟（gully）。

points.en: Water keeps flowing in the gully, so it gets wider and deeper and becomes a stream or river. Scientists call a creek, brook or river a stream.
points.zh: 水不断在冲沟里流，冲沟变宽变深，就成了溪流或河。科学家把小溪、小河、大河都叫作 stream（溪流）。

points.en: Great rivers, like the Mississippi River, drop their sediment where they enter the ocean. This makes a delta.
points.zh: 大河（比如密西西比河）在流入大海的地方放下沉积物，形成三角洲。

points.en: Ocean waves and currents carry sand off one beach and drop it on another beach.
points.zh: 海浪和洋流把一个海滩的沙带走，放到另一个海滩上。

remember.en: delta = sediment a river drops where it meets the ocean
remember.zh: 三角洲 = 河流入海时放下的沉积物

quick.q: A river drops its sediment at the ocean. This makes a...

why.en: Delta: the sediment fans out at the river mouth.
why.zh: 三角洲：沉积物在河口散开。

points.en: Glaciers are rivers and sheets of ice that stay all year. They move very slowly over land.
points.zh: 冰川是一年四季都在的冰河和冰盖，在陆地上非常慢地移动。

points.en: Glaciers can move boulders as big as houses. Over time they carve or deepen valleys.
points.zh: 冰川能推动像房子一样大的巨石，时间久了能刻出或加深山谷。

points.en: Fast wind carries sand and dust that scour (rub away) the surfaces they hit. Wind erosion is greatest in dry places like deserts, with little water and few trees.
points.zh: 快速的风带着沙子和尘土，磨掉它们撞到的表面。风的侵蚀在沙漠这样干燥、水少、树少的地方最强。

points.en: When the wind slows down, it drops its load of sand. This is how sand dunes are built.
points.zh: 风变慢时会放下带着的沙子，沙丘就是这样形成的。

quick.q: Sand dunes are built when the wind...

why.en: Slow wind cannot carry the sand, so it drops it.
why.zh: 风变慢带不动沙子，就把沙子放下。

points.en: Gravity is the force under ALL erosion and deposition.
points.zh: 重力是所有侵蚀和沉积背后的力量。

points.en: Gravity makes water and glaciers move downhill, and makes particles settle onto a stream bed, a lake bed or the ground.
points.zh: 重力让水和冰川往下坡流，也让颗粒沉到河床、湖底或地上。

points.en: Gravity can also cause erosion directly: landslides and mudflows.
points.zh: 重力也能直接造成侵蚀：山体滑坡和泥石流。

remember.en: 4 movers of sediment: water, ice, wind, gravity
remember.zh: 搬运沉积物的 4 个力量：水、冰、风、重力

quick.q: Which force is under ALL erosion and deposition?

why.en: Gravity pulls water, ice and sediment downhill.
why.zh: 重力把水、冰和沉积物往下拉。

title.en: Draw it: from rain to delta

points.en: Draw rain on a hill, a gully, a river, and a delta where the river meets the sea.
points.zh: 画山上的雨、冲沟、河流，以及河流入海处的三角洲。

prompt.en: Draw how water moves sediment from a hill to the sea. Label each part.
prompt.zh: 画出水如何把沉积物从山上带到海里，给每部分写标签。

canNow.en: I can now explain erosion and deposition and the four things that move sediment.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以解释侵蚀和沉积，以及搬运沉积物的四种力量。

points.en: A divide is a line of high land. Rainwater or melted snow runs down one side or the other side.
points.zh: 分水岭是一条高地线。雨水或融化的雪水从一边或另一边流下去。

points.en: A divide can cross a small hill or a whole mountain range.
points.zh: 分水岭可以经过一座小山，也可以是一整条山脉。

remember.en: divide = high land that splits where the water goes
remember.zh: 分水岭 = 把水分开流向不同方向的高地

quick.q: A divide is a line of...

why.en: Water runs DOWN from high land on each side.
why.zh: 水从高地两边往下流。

points.en: Water running down each side of a divide makes small streams. Small streams join into bigger streams, and then rivers.
points.zh: 从分水岭两边流下的水形成小溪，小溪汇成大溪，再汇成河。

points.en: A drainage basin is ALL the land where water collects and flows toward one river.
points.zh: 流域就是水汇集并流向同一条河的所有土地。

points.en: Drainage basin and watershed mean the same thing. Large drainage basins are made of many smaller ones.
points.zh: drainage basin 和 watershed 意思一样。大流域由很多小流域组成。

remember.en: drainage basin = watershed
remember.zh: drainage basin = watershed = 流域

quick.q: Drainage basin means the same as...

why.en: Drainage basin = watershed.
why.zh: drainage basin = watershed。

points.en: The Great Continental Divide runs through the Rocky Mountains, which run north to south through the United States and Canada.
points.zh: 大陆分水岭经过落基山脉，落基山脉从北到南穿过美国和加拿大。

points.en: From the WEST slopes of the Rockies, water runs toward the Pacific Ocean. From the EAST slopes, it runs toward the Gulf of Mexico.
points.zh: 从落基山脉西坡流下的水流向太平洋，从东坡流下的水流向墨西哥湾。

points.en: A smaller divide is in the Appalachian Mountains. West slopes: water flows to the Gulf of Mexico. East slopes: to the Atlantic Ocean.
points.zh: 阿巴拉契亚山脉有一条较小的分水岭。西坡的水流向墨西哥湾，东坡的水流向大西洋。

points.en: The largest drainage basin in the United States is the land between the Rocky Mountains and the Appalachian Mountains.
points.zh: 美国最大的流域是落基山脉和阿巴拉契亚山脉之间的土地。

remember.en: Rockies: west to the Pacific, east to the Gulf of Mexico
remember.zh: 落基山脉：西边流向太平洋，东边流向墨西哥湾

quick.q: Rain on the EAST side of the Rockies flows to the...

why.en: East slopes: Gulf of Mexico. West slopes: Pacific Ocean.
why.zh: 东坡流向墨西哥湾，西坡流向太平洋。

points.en: Draw a mountain with rain on top. Draw arrows to show the water running down BOTH sides into two rivers.
points.zh: 画一座山，山顶下雨。画箭头表示水从两边流下，流进两条河。

prompt.en: Draw a divide and two drainage basins. Label them.
prompt.zh: 画出分水岭和两个流域，并写上标签。

canNow.en: I can now explain a divide and a drainage basin, and where water goes from the Rocky Mountains.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以解释分水岭和流域，以及落基山脉的水流向哪里。

points.en: Evidence suggests Earth formed about 4.6 billion years ago.
points.zh: 证据表明地球大约在 46 亿年前形成。

points.en: Back then Earth was very hot. No water flowed, no wind blew, and nothing lived on it.
points.zh: 那时地球非常热。没有流水，没有风，也没有生物。

points.en: Over time all of this changed and made the Earth we know today. Scientists use theories to explain how.
points.zh: 经过很长时间，这些都改变了，形成了今天的地球。科学家用理论来解释是怎么变化的。

remember.en: Earth formed about 4.6 billion years ago
remember.zh: 地球大约在 46 亿年前形成

why.en: Billion: 4,600,000,000 years.

points.en: In 1795, the Scottish geologist James Hutton wrote a book called Theory of the Earth.
points.zh: 1795 年，苏格兰地质学家詹姆斯·赫顿写了一本书叫《地球的理论》。

points.en: The principle of uniformitarianism: the processes changing Earth's surface TODAY are the same as the ones that changed it in the PAST.
points.zh: 均变论原理：今天改变地球表面的过程，和过去改变地球表面的过程是一样的。

points.en: These processes are uplift (mountain building) and wearing down (weathering, erosion and deposition).
points.zh: 这些过程包括抬升（造山）和磨损（风化、侵蚀和沉积）。

points.en: Word Watch: uniform means "same".
points.zh: 词语小贴士：uniform 的意思是“相同”。

remember.en: uniformitarianism = same processes, then and now
remember.zh: 均变论 = 过去和现在是同样的过程

why.en: Uniform = same, like a school uniform: everyone looks the same.
why.zh: uniform = 相同，就像校服：大家穿得一样。

points.en: Weathered earth materials, shells and bone pieces settle in layers at the bottom of water.
points.zh: 风化的地球物质、贝壳和骨头碎片在水底一层一层地沉下来。

points.en: Over time they are pressed (compacted) and stuck (cemented) together. This makes sedimentary rock layers.
points.zh: 时间久了，它们被压紧、粘在一起，就形成了一层一层的沉积岩。

points.en: The principle of superposition: layers near the surface are YOUNGER than layers deeper down, unless something has disturbed them.
points.zh: 叠置原理：靠近地表的岩层比更深的岩层年轻，除非岩层被扰动过。

points.en: So each layer is older than the one above it and younger than the one below it.
points.zh: 所以每一层都比上面那层老，比下面那层年轻。

points.en: Think of a pile of homework sheets: the sheet at the bottom went on first, so it is the oldest.
points.zh: 想象一叠作业纸：最下面那张最先放上去，所以它最老。

points.en: Word Watch: super means "above". Position means "where something is".
points.zh: 词语小贴士：super 的意思是“在上面”，position 的意思是“位置”。

remember.en: bottom layer = oldest, top layer = youngest
remember.zh: 最下层 = 最老，最上层 = 最年轻

quick.q: In a pile of rock layers, the BOTTOM layer is usually the...

why.en: It was laid down first.
why.zh: 它最先形成。

points.en: Draw 4 rock layers in different colours and patterns: bricks, dots, stripes, speckles.
points.zh: 用不同颜色和花纹画 4 层岩石：砖块、点点、条纹、斑点。

prompt.en: Draw 4 rock layers. Number them 1 (oldest) to 4 (youngest).
prompt.zh: 画 4 层岩石，从 1（最老）到 4（最年轻）编号。

canNow.en: I can now explain uniformitarianism and use superposition to say which rock layer is older.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以解释均变论，并用叠置原理判断哪一层岩石更老。

points.en: A geologic cross-section is a cutaway view of the rocks in one place, like cutting a layer cake to see inside.
points.zh: 地质剖面就是把一个地方的岩石切开看，就像切开千层蛋糕看里面。

points.en: You can sometimes see cross-sections at road cuts, where a road is cut through a hill.
points.zh: 有时在路堑（公路穿过山丘切开的地方）能看到剖面。

points.en: Geologic principles help us "read" the story in a cross-section.
points.zh: 地质原理帮助我们“读懂”剖面里的故事。

points.en: Magma is molten (melted) rock. It can move up through cracks and cut through sedimentary rock layers.
points.zh: 岩浆是熔化的岩石。它能沿着裂缝往上走，切穿沉积岩层。

points.en: The principle of cross-cutting relationships: anything that cuts through layers is YOUNGER than all the layers it cuts.
points.zh: 切割关系原理：切穿岩层的东西，比它切穿的所有岩层都年轻。

points.en: Why? The layers had to be there first before the magma could cut them.
points.zh: 为什么？岩层必须先存在，岩浆才能切穿它们。

remember.en: the cutter is younger than what it cuts
remember.zh: 切穿别人的比被切穿的年轻

quick.q: Magma cuts through 3 rock layers. The magma is...

why.en: The layers had to be there first.
why.zh: 岩层必须先存在。

points.en: After layers form, uplift can raise them to Earth's surface, and erosion wears some of them away.
points.zh: 岩层形成后，抬升会把它们升到地表，侵蚀再磨掉一些。

points.en: An unconformity is a place where rock layers are MISSING.
points.zh: 不整合就是岩层缺失的地方。

points.en: The layers above an unconformity are a different kind of rock from the layers below it.
points.zh: 不整合上面的岩层和下面的岩层是不同种类的岩石。

remember.en: unconformity = missing layers (a wavy line in diagrams)
remember.zh: 不整合 = 缺失的岩层（图里常画成波浪线）

quick.q: At an unconformity, rock layers are...

why.en: Erosion wore them away.
why.zh: 侵蚀把它们磨掉了。

title.en: Read the story, step by step

points.en: Step 1: start at the BOTTOM. The lowest layer is the oldest.
points.zh: 第 1 步：从最下面开始。最下面的岩层最老。

points.en: Step 2: go UP one layer at a time. Each one is younger.
points.zh: 第 2 步：一层一层往上看，每一层都更年轻。

points.en: Step 3: anything that CUTS through layers (like magma) is younger than those layers.
points.zh: 第 3 步：切穿岩层的东西（比如岩浆）比那些岩层年轻。

points.en: Step 4: a wavy line means an unconformity: some layers are missing there.
points.zh: 第 4 步：波浪线表示不整合：那里缺了一些岩层。

prompt.en: Draw your own cross-section: 3 layers, magma cutting through, and a wavy line. Label oldest, youngest, magma, unconformity.
prompt.zh: 画你自己的剖面：3 层岩石、切穿的岩浆和一条波浪线。标出最老、最年轻、岩浆、不整合。

canNow.en: I can now read a geologic cross-section: oldest at the bottom, cutters are younger, wavy line means missing layers.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以读懂地质剖面：最下面最老，切穿的更年轻，波浪线表示岩层缺失。

points.en: Continents do not stop at the shoreline. They continue under the sea. This part is the continental margin.
points.zh: 大陆并不在海岸线结束，它们在海下继续延伸。这部分叫大陆边缘。

points.en: The continental margin has three parts: the continental shelf, the continental slope and the continental rise.
points.zh: 大陆边缘有三部分：大陆架、大陆坡和大陆隆。

points.en: After the rise comes the deep, flat abyssal plain.
points.zh: 大陆隆之后是又深又平的深海平原。

remember.en: shelf, slope, rise, then the abyssal plain
remember.zh: 大陆架、大陆坡、大陆隆，然后是深海平原

quick.q: Going out from the beach, what comes FIRST?

why.en: Shelf first, then slope, rise and the abyssal plain.
why.zh: 先是大陆架，再是大陆坡、大陆隆和深海平原。

title.zh: 大陆架、大陆坡、大陆隆、深海平原

points.en: Continental shelf: nearest the shore. It slopes gently and the water is up to about 150 to 200 meters deep.
points.zh: 大陆架：离海岸最近，坡度平缓，水深最多大约 150 到 200 米。

points.en: Continental slope: where the land drops steeply, down to about 4000 meters deep. Deep submarine canyons cut into it. Rivers most likely carved them.
points.zh: 大陆坡：海底陡峭地往下降，深到大约 4000 米。深深的海底峡谷切进大陆坡，很可能是河流刻出来的。

points.en: Continental rise: at the bottom of the slope, the margin levels out. It is covered by sediment that drifted down from the shelf and slope.
points.zh: 大陆隆：在大陆坡底部，海底变平缓，上面盖着从大陆架和大陆坡飘下来的沉积物。

points.en: Abyssal plain: the deep, flat ocean floor after the rise.
points.zh: 深海平原：大陆隆之后又深又平的海底。

remember.en: shelf = gentle, slope = steep, rise = sediment
remember.zh: 大陆架 = 平缓，大陆坡 = 陡峭，大陆隆 = 沉积物

prompt.en: Draw the ocean floor from the beach to the deep ocean. Label each part.
prompt.zh: 画出从海滩到深海的海底，给每部分写标签。

points.en: A passive margin has NO plate boundary near it. Example: the east coast of North America.
points.zh: 被动大陆边缘附近没有板块边界。例子：北美洲东海岸。

points.en: Passive margins have WIDE continental shelves that reach 100 kilometers or more into the ocean before dropping off at the continental slope.
points.zh: 被动大陆边缘的大陆架很宽，向海里延伸 100 千米或更远，才到大陆坡。

remember.en: passive = no plate boundary = wide shelf
remember.zh: 被动 = 没有板块边界 = 宽大陆架

quick.q: A passive margin has a ___ shelf.

why.en: No plate boundary, so the shelf is wide (100 km or more).
why.zh: 没有板块边界，所以大陆架宽（100 千米或更多）。

points.en: An active margin HAS plate boundaries near it. Example: the west coast of North America.
points.zh: 主动大陆边缘附近有板块边界。例子：北美洲西海岸。

points.en: Active margins have NARROW shelves, only about 50 kilometers or less.
points.zh: 主动大陆边缘的大陆架很窄，只有大约 50 千米或更短。

points.en: They often have deep-sea trenches, the lowest places on Earth. Trenches form at convergent plate boundaries, where heavier (denser) ocean crust dives under continental crust.
points.zh: 那里常有深海海沟，是地球上最低的地方。海沟在汇聚板块边界形成，较重（密度更大）的海洋地壳钻到大陆地壳下面。

points.en: Volcanoes and earthquakes are common on land near an active margin.
points.zh: 主动大陆边缘附近的陆地上常有火山和地震。

remember.en: active = plate boundary = narrow shelf + trench + volcanoes
remember.zh: 主动 = 有板块边界 = 窄大陆架 + 海沟 + 火山

why.en: Trenches: convergent (come together). Ridges: divergent (move apart).
why.zh: 海沟：汇聚（靠拢）。洋中脊：离散（分开）。

points.en: Mid-ocean ridges are long mountain chains that snake through Earth's oceans.
points.zh: 大洋中脊是在地球海洋里蜿蜒的长长山脉。

points.en: Together they are Earth's longest continuous mountain range, about 60,000 kilometers long.
points.zh: 它们连在一起是地球上最长的连续山脉，大约 60,000 千米长。

points.en: They form at DIVERGENT boundaries, where plates move apart. Converge = come together. Diverge = move apart.
points.zh: 它们在离散板块边界形成，也就是板块分开的地方。converge = 靠拢，diverge = 分开。

remember.en: trench = convergent, ridge = divergent
remember.zh: 海沟 = 汇聚，洋中脊 = 离散

why.en: 60,000 km: Earth's longest mountain range.
why.zh: 60,000 千米：地球上最长的山脉。

canNow.en: I can now label the ocean floor and explain passive and active margins, trenches and ridges.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以标出海底各部分，并解释被动和主动大陆边缘、海沟和洋中脊。

points.en: BRING means carry something TOWARD the speaker (to here). Please bring me that game.
points.zh: bring 是把东西拿到说话人这里来。Please bring me that game.（请把那个游戏拿给我。）

points.en: TAKE means carry something AWAY (to there). Take these flowers home with you.
points.zh: take 是把东西拿走、带到别处去。Take these flowers home with you.（把这些花带回家。）

remember.en: bring = here, take = there
remember.zh: bring = 拿来这里，take = 拿去那里

why.en: To me = bring.
why.zh: 拿给我 = bring。

title.en: fewer or less? than or then?
title.zh: fewer 还是 less？than 还是 then？

points.en: FEWER is for things you can COUNT: fewer people, fewer apples. LESS is for things you cannot count: less water, less time.
points.zh: fewer 用于能数的东西：fewer people。less 用于不能数的东西：less water。

points.en: THAN compares two things: taller than Tom. THEN tells WHEN: we ate, then we swam.
points.zh: than 用来比较：taller than Tom。then 表示时间“然后”：we ate, then we swam。

remember.en: count it = fewer; compare = than
remember.zh: 能数 = fewer；比较 = than

quick.q: There were ___ cars on the road.

why.en: Cars can be counted: fewer.
why.zh: 车可以数：fewer。

title.en: accept or except? already or all ready?
title.zh: accept 还是 except？already 还是 all ready？

points.en: ACCEPT means to say yes and take something: accept a gift. EXCEPT means "but not": everyone except me.
points.zh: accept 是接受：accept a gift。except 是“除了”：everyone except me。

points.en: ALREADY means "before now": she already knew. ALL READY means "everyone or everything is ready": we are all ready to go.
points.zh: already 是“已经”：she already knew。all ready 是“全都准备好了”：we are all ready to go。

points.en: BETWEEN is for two things. AMONG is for three or more.
points.zh: between 用于两者之间，among 用于三个或更多之间。

remember.en: between 2, among 3 or more
remember.zh: between 两者之间，among 三者以上

why.en: But not Tom: except.
why.zh: 除了 Tom：except。

points.en: would OF → would HAVE (also could have, should have)
points.zh: would of → would have（could have、should have 也一样）

points.en: had ought → ought; sort of mysterious → rather mysterious; how come → why
points.zh: had ought → ought；sort of → rather；how come → why

points.en: try and → try to; ain't → isn't; alot → a lot; allright → all right
points.zh: try and → try to；ain't → isn't；alot → a lot；allright → all right

points.en: somewheres, anywheres, a long ways → somewhere, anywhere, a long way
points.zh: somewheres、anywheres、a long ways → somewhere、anywhere、a long way

points.en: the story where it explained → the story that explained; where it was at → where it was
points.zh: the story where it explained → the story that explained；where it was at → where it was

remember.en: If it sounds like chatting, check it before you write it.
remember.zh: 听起来像聊天的说法，写之前先检查。

why.en: Would of is never correct.
why.zh: would of 永远是错的。

points.en: TEACH means to show someone else how: Mrs. Brown teaches her students.
points.zh: teach 是教别人：Mrs. Brown teaches her students。

points.en: LEARN means to get the knowledge yourself: the students learn the basics.
points.zh: learn 是自己学会：the students learn the basics。

canNow.en: I can now choose the correct word: bring or take, fewer or less, than or then, and more.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以选对词：bring 或 take、fewer 或 less、than 或 then 等。

points.en: Some words sound the same but mean different things. Test: say the long form.
points.zh: 有些词读音一样，意思不同。检查方法：把缩写展开说。

points.en: you're = you are. your = belongs to you. "You are ordinary bear" makes no sense, so write YOUR ordinary bear.
points.zh: you're = you are；your = 你的。“You are ordinary bear”说不通，所以写 your ordinary bear。

points.en: they're = they are. their = belongs to them. there = a place.
points.zh: they're = they are；their = 他们的；there = 那里。

points.en: it's = it is. its = belongs to it. who's = who is. whose = belongs to whom.
points.zh: it's = it is；its = 它的；who's = who is；whose = 谁的。

remember.en: If "it is" fits, write it's. If not, write its.
remember.zh: 能换成 it is 就写 it's，不能就写 its。

why.en: Say it in full: "You are coat" makes no sense, so Your.
why.zh: 展开说：You are coat 说不通，所以用 Your。

points.en: USED TO (past habit): it used to be a myth. But "a thumb they USE TO strip leaves" is correct (use it to do something).
points.zh: used to（过去常常）：it used to be a myth。但 a thumb they use to strip leaves 是对的（用它来做事）。

points.en: AN before a vowel sound: an adult, an apple. A before other sounds: a panda.
points.zh: 元音音素前用 an：an adult、an apple；其他用 a：a panda。

points.en: off of → off: strip the leaves off the bamboo. this here thumb → this thumb.
points.zh: off of → off：strip the leaves off the bamboo。this here thumb → this thumb。

canNow.en: I can now find and fix sound-alike mistakes like your/you're, their/there and its/it's.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以找出并改正 your/you're、their/there、its/it's 这类错误。

points.en: A flyer is one page that tells people about an event so they want to come.
points.zh: 宣传单是一页纸，介绍一个活动，让人们想来参加。

points.en: It must say WHAT the event is, WHEN (date and time), WHERE, and the ACTIVITIES.
points.zh: 一定要写清楚：什么活动、什么时候（日期和时间）、在哪里、有什么活动项目。

quick.q: A flyer must say WHAT, WHEN, WHERE and the...

why.en: What, when, where and the activities, so people want to come.
why.zh: 什么活动、什么时候、在哪里、有哪些项目，让人想来参加。

points.en: Step 1: plan. Write the event name, date, time, place and 3 or 4 activities.
points.zh: 第 1 步：计划。写下活动名称、日期、时间、地点和 3 到 4 个活动项目。

points.en: Step 2: write short, friendly sentences. Use the usage words correctly (a lot, there, their, an, ought to, fewer, than, all right...).
points.zh: 第 2 步：写简短友好的句子，正确使用学过的用法词（a lot、there、their、an、ought to、fewer、than、all right……）。

points.en: Step 3: underline at least 10 usage examples. Check capital letters and full stops.
points.zh: 第 3 步：至少划出 10 个用法例子。检查大写字母和句号。

remember.en: what, when, where, activities + 10 underlined usage words
remember.zh: 什么、何时、何地、活动 + 10 个划线的用法词

points.en: Big headline at the top: the event name. Example: Spring Science Fair!
points.zh: 最上面写大标题：活动名称。例如：Spring Science Fair!

points.en: Short lines and a bullet list (• one idea per line) are easier to read than long paragraphs.
points.zh: 短句和项目列表（• 每行一个点）比长段落更容易读。

points.en: End with a call to action: tell people what to do. Come and join us! Bring a friend!
points.zh: 最后写行动号召：告诉人们要做什么。Come and join us!（快来参加！）Bring a friend!（带上朋友！）

quick.q: Which line is a call to action?

why.en: A call to action tells the reader what to do.
why.zh: 行动号召告诉读者要做什么。

points.en: SPRING SCIENCE FAIR! When: Saturday 5 December, 9:00 to 12:00. Where: the school hall.
points.zh: SPRING SCIENCE FAIR!（春季科学展）时间：12 月 5 日星期六，9:00 到 12:00。地点：学校礼堂。

points.en: • There will be a lot of experiments. • Students will show their volcano models. • Have an ice cream after the show.
points.zh: • There will be a lot of experiments.（会有很多实验。）• Students will show their volcano models.（学生会展示他们的火山模型。）• Have an ice cream after the show.（看完来个冰淇淋。）

points.en: Usage words used: there, a lot, their, an (before ice), after. Come and join us!
points.zh: 用到的用法词：there、a lot、their、an（ice 前面）、after。Come and join us!

quick.q: Which sentence is correct for the flyer?
options: Their will be alot of games.
There will be a lot of games.

why.en: THERE = a place or "there will be". A LOT is two words.
why.zh: THERE 表示地点或 "there will be"（将会有）。A LOT 是两个词。

title.en: Check before you hand it in

points.en: Does it say what, when, where and the activities? Is there a call to action?
points.zh: 有没有写什么活动、什么时候、在哪里和活动项目？有没有行动号召？

points.en: Are at least 10 usage words underlined and correct? Capital letters and full stops?
points.zh: 至少 10 个用法词划线并且用对了吗？大写字母和句号都对吗？

quick.q: Which is correct on a flyer?
options: There will be fewer queues this year.
There will be less queues this year.

why.en: Queues can be counted, so use FEWER.
why.zh: 队伍可以数，所以用 FEWER。

canNow.en: I can now plan and write a flyer with the date, time, activities and correct usage words.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以计划并写一张有日期、时间、活动和正确用法词的宣传单。

points.en: A subject pronoun DOES the action. It usually comes before the verb.
points.zh: 主格代词是做动作的人，通常在动词前面。

points.en: I, you, he, she, it, we, they.
points.zh: I、you、he、she、it、we、they。

points.en: She plays the piano. We went to the beach.
points.zh: She plays the piano. We went to the beach.

points.en: An object pronoun RECEIVES the action. It comes after the verb or after words like to, for, with, between.
points.zh: 宾格代词是接受动作的，在动词后面，或在 to、for、with、between 这些词后面。

points.en: me, you, him, her, it, us, them.
points.zh: me、you、him、her、it、us、them。

points.en: Tom helped me. The gift is for them.
points.zh: Tom helped me. The gift is for them.

why.en: After "to", use the object pronoun: him.
why.zh: 在 to 后面用宾格：him。

title.en: The cover-up test for two people

points.en: "Emma and I went to the park" or "Emma and me went"? Cover up "Emma and": I went. So: Emma and I went.
points.zh: “Emma and I went” 还是 “Emma and me went”？遮住 “Emma and”：I went。所以是 Emma and I went。

points.en: "Mom made lunch for Emma and I" or "for Emma and me"? Cover it up: for me. So: for Emma and me.
points.zh: “for Emma and I” 还是 “for Emma and me”？遮住：for me。所以是 for Emma and me。

points.en: Polite order: put yourself LAST: "Emma and I", not "I and Emma".
points.zh: 礼貌的顺序：把自己放在最后：Emma and I，不说 I and Emma。

remember.en: Cover the other person, then listen.
remember.zh: 遮住另一个人，再听一听。

why.en: Cover "and Lily": She is a friend. Subject: She.
why.zh: 遮住 and Lily：She is a friend。主格：She。

canNow.en: I can now choose subject or object pronouns, even with two people.
canNow.zh: 我现在会选主格或宾格代词，两个人时也会。

title.zh: 比较 2 个还是 3 个以上

points.en: Comparative: compare TWO things. Add -er or use more: taller, more beautiful.
points.zh: 比较级：比较两个东西。加 -er 或用 more：taller、more beautiful。

points.en: Superlative: compare THREE or more. Add -est or use most: tallest, most beautiful. Use "the" before it.
points.zh: 最高级：比较三个或更多。加 -est 或用 most：tallest、most beautiful。前面用 the。

points.en: Tom is taller than Sam. Tom is the tallest boy in the class.
points.zh: Tom is taller than Sam. Tom is the tallest boy in the class.

points.en: Short words (1 syllable): add -er, -est: fast, faster, fastest.
points.zh: 短词（1 个音节）：加 -er、-est：fast、faster、fastest。

points.en: Ends in e: add -r, -st: large, larger, largest. Short vowel + 1 consonant: double it: big, bigger, biggest.
points.zh: 以 e 结尾：加 -r、-st：large、larger、largest。短元音加一个辅音：双写：big、bigger、biggest。

points.en: Ends in y: change y to i: happy, happier, happiest.
points.zh: 以 y 结尾：把 y 变成 i：happy、happier、happiest。

points.en: Long words (3+ syllables, and most 2-syllable words): more, most: more careful, most careful.
points.zh: 长词（3 个以上音节，和大部分 2 个音节的词）：用 more、most：more careful、most careful。

quick.q: This is the ___ day of the year.

why.en: Happy ends in y: happiest.
why.zh: happy 以 y 结尾：happiest。

points.en: good → better → best.   bad → worse → worst.
points.zh: good → better → best；bad → worse → worst。

points.en: many / much → more → most.   little → less → least.   far → farther → farthest.
points.zh: many / much → more → most；little → less → least；far → farther → farthest。

quick.q: My cold is ___ today than yesterday.

why.en: Bad is irregular: bad, worse, worst.
why.zh: bad 是不规则的：bad、worse、worst。

points.en: Use -er OR more, never both. Use -est OR most, never both.
points.zh: 用 -er 或 more，不能都用；用 -est 或 most，不能都用。

points.en: ✗ more taller  ✓ taller.   ✗ most fastest  ✓ fastest.   ✗ more better  ✓ better.
points.zh: ✗ more taller ✓ taller；✗ most fastest ✓ fastest；✗ more better ✓ better。

remember.en: One comparison word is enough.
remember.zh: 一个比较词就够了。

options: She is the most fastest runner.

why.en: Fastest already means "most fast". Most fastest is a double comparison.
why.zh: fastest 已经是“最快”的意思，most fastest 是双重比较。

canNow.en: I can now use comparatives and superlatives and avoid double comparisons.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用比较级和最高级，并避免双重比较。

points.en: Negative words mean "no": not (n't), no, never, nobody, nothing, none, nowhere, no one.
points.zh: 否定词表示“没有”：not (n't)、no、never、nobody、nothing、none、nowhere、no one。

points.en: Hardly, scarcely and barely are negative words too.
points.zh: hardly、scarcely 和 barely 也是否定词。

points.en: A double negative is two negative words in one sentence part. In correct English, use only ONE.
points.zh: 双重否定是一个句子里用了两个否定词。正确的英语只用一个。

points.en: ✗ I don't have no money.  ✓ I don't have any money.  ✓ I have no money.
points.zh: ✗ I don't have no money. ✓ I don't have any money. ✓ I have no money.

points.en: ✗ Nobody never calls me.  ✓ Nobody ever calls me.
points.zh: ✗ Nobody never calls me. ✓ Nobody ever calls me.

points.en: ✗ I can't hardly see.  ✓ I can hardly see.
points.zh: ✗ I can't hardly see. ✓ I can hardly see.

remember.en: Swap the second negative for a positive word: no → any, never → ever, nothing → anything, nobody → anybody.
remember.zh: 把第二个否定词换成肯定词：no → any，never → ever，nothing → anything，nobody → anybody。

why.en: Didn't is already negative, so use anything.
why.zh: didn't 已经是否定，所以用 anything。

points.en: Draw a shop sign that says: "We don't have no ice cream." Cross out the mistake.
points.zh: 画一个店的牌子，上面写着：“We don't have no ice cream.” 把错误划掉。

points.en: Draw a new sign with the correct sentence, two ways: "We don't have any ice cream." and "We have no ice cream."
points.zh: 画一个新牌子，用两种正确的写法：“We don't have any ice cream.” 和 “We have no ice cream.”

prompt.en: Draw the wrong sign and two correct signs.
prompt.zh: 画错误的牌子和两个正确的牌子。

canNow.en: I can now find and fix double negatives.
canNow.zh: 我现在能找到并改正双重否定。

points.en: Act 1, beginning (setup): meet the character and the setting. Then something happens that starts the PROBLEM.
points.zh: 第一幕，开头（铺垫）：认识人物和背景，然后发生一件事，引出问题。

points.en: Act 2, middle (confrontation): the character tries to solve the problem. Things get harder and harder until the most exciting moment: the climax.
points.zh: 第二幕，中间（冲突）：人物想办法解决问题，事情越来越难，直到最精彩的时刻：高潮。

points.en: Act 3, end (resolution): the problem is solved, and we see how the character has changed.
points.zh: 第三幕，结尾（结局）：问题解决了，我们看到人物有了什么变化。

points.en: Act 1: Emma loves her cat, Milo. One stormy night, Milo disappears.
points.zh: 第一幕：Emma 很爱她的猫 Milo。一个暴风雨的晚上，Milo 不见了。

points.en: Act 2: Emma searches the garden and the street, and puts up posters. Nobody has seen him. At midnight she hears a tiny meow from the old shed (the climax).
points.zh: 第二幕：Emma 找了花园和街道，还贴了寻猫启事，可是没人见过它。半夜，她听到旧棚子里传来一声小小的“喵”（高潮）。

points.en: Act 3: Milo is safe. Emma learns that never giving up pays off.
points.zh: 第三幕：Milo 平安无事。Emma 明白了永不放弃是值得的。

quick.q: The most exciting moment of a story is the...

why.en: The climax is the top of Act 2, the most exciting part.
why.zh: 高潮在第二幕的最高点，是最精彩的部分。

points.en: Draw a mountain. At the bottom left write Act 1. Up the side write Act 2. At the top write CLIMAX. Down the other side write Act 3.
points.zh: 画一座山。左下写第一幕，沿山坡往上写第二幕，山顶写高潮，另一边往下写第三幕。

points.en: Plan your own story on it: one picture and one sentence for each part.
points.zh: 在山上计划你自己的故事：每个部分画一幅图、写一句话。

prompt.en: Draw a story mountain and plan your own 3-act story.
prompt.zh: 画一座故事山，计划你自己的三幕故事。

canNow.en: I can now plan a story with a beginning, a middle with a climax, and an end.
canNow.zh: 我现在会计划一个有开头、有高潮的中间和结尾的故事。

points.en: An equation has two sides that are equal, like a balance scale that stays level.
points.zh: 方程两边相等，就像一个保持平衡的天平。

points.en: Whatever you do to one side, you MUST do to the other side.
points.zh: 一边做什么，另一边也必须做同样的事。

points.en: × is undone by ÷. ÷ is undone by ×.
points.zh: × 用 ÷ 抵消，÷ 用 × 抵消。

points.en: 6m means 6 × m. So to undo it, divide both sides by 6.
points.zh: 6m 就是 6 × m，所以两边同时除以 6 来抵消。

points.en: Step 1: what is happening to m? It is MULTIPLIED by 6.
points.zh: 第 1 步：m 怎么了？它被乘以 6。

points.en: Step 2: do the opposite to both sides: 42 ÷ 6 = 7.
points.zh: 第 2 步：两边做相反运算：42 ÷ 6 = 7。

points.en: Step 3: finish the answer as letter = number: m = 7.
points.zh: 第 3 步：答案写成“字母 = 数字”：m = 7。

points.en: Step 4: check it! 6 × 7 = 42. ✓

remember.en: Always finish: m = 7, not 42 ÷ 6
remember.zh: 答案要写完整：m = 7，不是 42 ÷ 6

quick.q: 7r = 56. What do you do to both sides?

why.en: The opposite of × 7 is ÷ 7, so r = 8.
why.zh: × 7 的相反是 ÷ 7，所以 r = 8。

canNow.en: I can now solve × and ÷ equations and check my answer.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以解乘除方程并检查答案。

title.en: Fraction Equations with a Bar Model

points.en: s is an unknown number. A number right next to a letter means multiply: 3/5 s = 3/5 × s.
points.zh: s 是一个未知数。数字直接写在字母旁边表示乘：3/5 s = 3/5 × s。

points.en: So 3/5 s means 3/5 of s: cut s into 5 equal parts and take 3 of them.
points.zh: 所以 3/5 s 就是 s 的 3/5：把 s 平均分成 5 份，取其中 3 份。

points.en: A bar model is a long box cut into equal parts. It helps you SEE the fraction.
points.zh: 线段图（bar model）是一个分成相等几份的长方框，帮你“看见”分数。

quick.q: In 2/7 n, the bar for n is cut into how many equal parts?

why.en: The BOTTOM number tells how many equal parts the whole is cut into.
why.zh: 分母（下面的数）告诉你整体平均分成几份。

points.en: Step 1: 3/5 s means 3 out of 5 equal parts of s is 9. Draw s and cut it into 5 equal parts.
points.zh: 第 1 步：3/5 s 的意思是 s 的 5 等份里的 3 份是 9。画出 s，分成 5 等份。

points.en: Step 2: 3 parts = 9, so 1 part = 9 ÷ 3 = 3.
Step 3: s is ALL 5 parts: s = 5 × 3 = 15.
points.zh: 第 3 步：s 是全部 5 份：s = 5 × 3 = 15。

points.en: Step 4: check it! 3/5 of 15 = 9. ✓

remember.en: divide by the TOP number, then multiply by the BOTTOM number
remember.zh: 先除以分子，再乘以分母

quick.q: 3/4 of a number is 12. One part (1/4) is...

why.en: 3 parts = 12, so 1 part = 12 ÷ 3 = 4.

title.en: Another way: multiply by the flipped fraction
title.zh: 另一种方法：乘以倒过来的分数

points.en: 3/5 s = 9. To undo × 3/5, multiply both sides by 5/3 (the fraction flipped).
points.zh: 3/5 s = 9。要抵消 × 3/5，两边都乘以 5/3（把分数倒过来）。

points.en: s = 9 × 5/3 = 45/3 = 15. Same answer as the bar model!

why.en: n = 10 × 5/2 = 50/2 = 25. Check: 2/5 × 25 = 10. (4 comes from 10 × 2/5, forgetting to flip.)

title.en: Word problem with a bar model

points.en: Tom has read 2/3 of his book. That is 24 pages. How many pages are in the whole book?
points.zh: Tom 读了他的书的 2/3，一共 24 页。整本书有多少页？

points.en: Equation: 2/3 p = 24. Draw p in 3 equal parts. 2 parts = 24, so 1 part = 24 ÷ 2 = 12.
p = 3 × 12 = 36. Answer: 36 pages. Check: 2/3 of 36 = 24. ✓

remember.en: The whole is BIGGER than the part, so p must be more than 24.
remember.zh: 整体比部分大，所以 p 一定大于 24。

why.en: 1 part = 12 ÷ 3 = 4, so x = 4 × 4 = 16. (9 is 3/4 of 12, not the whole.)

points.en: 4/7 y = 12. Step 1: 4 parts = 12, so 1 part = 12 ÷ 4 = 3.
Step 2: y is all 7 parts: y = 7 × 3 = 21. Step 3: check: 4/7 × 21 = 84/7 = 12. ✓

quick.q: 4/7 y = 12. One part is 3. What is y?

why.en: y is all 7 parts: 7 × 3 = 21.

canNow.en: I can now solve fraction equations with a bar model.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以用线段图解分数方程。

title.zh: 表达式和指数（第 7 章）

points.en: An exponent tells how many times to multiply the base by itself.
points.zh: 指数表示底数自己乘自己几次。

points.en: 2³: the base is 2 and the exponent is 3. 2³ = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.
Say it: 5² is "5 squared" = 5 × 5 = 25. 2³ is "2 cubed" = 8.
points.zh: 读法：5² 读作“5 的平方” = 5 × 5 = 25；2³ 读作“2 的立方” = 8。

points.en: Careful: 2³ is NOT 2 × 3.
points.zh: 注意：2³ 不是 2 × 3。

remember.en: Exponent = how many times you multiply, not what you multiply by.
remember.zh: 指数 = 乘几次，不是乘几。

points.en: 1. Parentheses ( ) first.  2. Exponents.  3. Multiply and divide, left to right.  4. Add and subtract, left to right.
points.zh: 1. 先算括号。2. 指数。3. 乘除，从左到右。4. 加减，从左到右。

points.en: With parentheses: (3 + 2)² = 5² = 25.

remember.en: Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally: P, E, M/D, A/S.
remember.zh: 记法 PEMDAS：括号、指数、乘除、加减。

why.en: Exponent first: 3² = 9. Then 6 + 9 = 15.

points.en: A variable is a letter that stands for a number, like n or x.
points.zh: 变量是代表一个数的字母，比如 n 或 x。

points.en: In 4x + 7: 4x and 7 are terms. 4 is the coefficient (the number in front of x). 7 is a constant (a number on its own).
points.zh: 在 4x + 7 里：4x 和 7 是项。4 是系数（x 前面的数），7 是常数（单独的数）。

points.en: An expression has no equals sign: 4x + 7. An equation has one: 4x + 7 = 15.
points.zh: 表达式没有等号：4x + 7。方程有等号：4x + 7 = 15。

why.en: The coefficient is the number multiplying the variable.
why.zh: 系数是乘变量的那个数。

points.en: "5 more than n" → n + 5.   "3 times a number x" → 3x.
points.zh: “比 n 多 5” → n + 5。“一个数 x 的 3 倍” → 3x。

points.en: "8 less than x" → x − 8. Careful: the order flips! It is NOT 8 − x.
points.zh: “比 x 少 8” → x − 8。注意：顺序反过来！不是 8 − x。

points.en: "a number divided by 4" → n ÷ 4 or n/4.
points.zh: “一个数除以 4” → n ÷ 4 或 n/4。

why.en: Less than flips the order: start with x, then take away 8.
why.zh: “比……少”顺序要反过来：先写 x，再减 8。

points.en: To evaluate, replace the variable with its number, then use the order of operations.
points.zh: 求值：把变量换成它的数，再按运算顺序算。

points.en: Formulas work the same way. Area of a rectangle: A = l × w. If l = 8 cm and w = 5 cm, A = 8 × 5 = 40 cm².
points.zh: 公式也一样。长方形面积：A = l × w。如果 l = 8 cm，w = 5 cm，A = 8 × 5 = 40 cm²。

points.en: Like terms have the SAME variable: 3x and 2x are like terms. 3x and 2 are not.
points.zh: 同类项的变量相同：3x 和 2x 是同类项；3x 和 2 不是。

points.en: Add or subtract the coefficients: 3x + 2x = 5x.  5y − 2y = 3y.
points.zh: 把系数加减：3x + 2x = 5x；5y − 2y = 3y。

points.en: 4a + 3 + 2a = 6a + 3 (the 3 stays on its own).

remember.en: Only apples with apples: x with x, numbers with numbers.
remember.zh: 苹果只能和苹果加：x 和 x，数和数。

why.en: 4a and 2a are like terms: 6a. The 3 has no a, so it stays.
why.zh: 4a 和 2a 是同类项：6a。3 没有 a，所以单独留着。

points.en: Equivalent expressions are always equal, whatever number the variable is.
points.zh: 等价表达式：不管变量是什么数，它们都相等。

points.en: The distributive property: 3(x + 2) = 3x + 6. Multiply the 3 by EVERY term inside.
points.zh: 分配律：3(x + 2) = 3x + 6。把 3 乘括号里的每一项。

points.en: Check by trying a number: if x = 1, 3(1 + 2) = 9 and 3 × 1 + 6 = 9. Same, so they are equivalent.

why.en: Multiply 2 by BOTH terms: 2 × y and 2 × 5.
why.zh: 2 要乘两项：2 × y 和 2 × 5。

title.en: Draw it: like terms as boxes

points.en: Draw 4 long bars and label each one x. Draw 3 small squares and label each one 1. Then draw 2 more x bars.
points.zh: 画 4 个长条，每个写 x；画 3 个小方块，每个写 1；再画 2 个 x 长条。

points.en: Circle all the x bars together and all the 1s together. Write the answer: 4x + 3 + 2x = 6x + 3.
points.zh: 把所有 x 长条圈在一起，把所有 1 圈在一起。写出答案：4x + 3 + 2x = 6x + 3。

prompt.en: Draw 4x + 3 + 2x with bars and squares, then combine like terms.
prompt.zh: 用长条和方块画出 4x + 3 + 2x，再合并同类项。

canNow.en: I can now use exponents, the order of operations, write and evaluate expressions, and combine like terms.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用指数和运算顺序，会写表达式、求值，会合并同类项。

points.en: A solution is the number that makes an equation TRUE.
points.zh: 解是让方程成立的那个数。

points.en: Is 7 a solution of x + 5 = 12? Put 7 in: 7 + 5 = 12. True, so yes.
points.zh: 7 是 x + 5 = 12 的解吗？把 7 代进去：7 + 5 = 12。成立，所以是。

points.en: Is 6 a solution? 6 + 5 = 11, not 12. No.

why.en: Put 9 in: 9 − 4 = 5. True.
why.zh: 把 9 代进去：9 − 4 = 5，成立。

points.en: x + 9 = 15. Something is ADDED to x, so SUBTRACT 9 from both sides.
points.zh: x + 9 = 15。x 加了 9，所以两边都减 9。

why.en: Subtract 18 from both sides: 31 − 18 = 13. Check: 13 + 18 = 31.

points.en: y − 4 = 10. Something is TAKEN AWAY from y, so ADD 4 to both sides.
points.zh: y − 4 = 10。y 减了 4，所以两边都加 4。

remember.en: Do the OPPOSITE to both sides: + undoes −, − undoes +, × undoes ÷, ÷ undoes ×.
remember.zh: 两边做相反的运算：+ 抵消 −，− 抵消 +，× 抵消 ÷，÷ 抵消 ×。

why.en: Add 7 to both sides: 25 + 7 = 32. Check: 32 − 7 = 25.

points.en: Emma had some stickers. She got 8 more. Now she has 20. How many did she have at first?
points.zh: Emma 有一些贴纸，又得到 8 张，现在有 20 张。她一开始有多少张？

points.en: Step 1: let s = the stickers at first. Step 2: write the equation: s + 8 = 20.
points.zh: 第 1 步：设 s = 一开始的贴纸。第 2 步：写方程：s + 8 = 20。

points.en: Step 3: s = 20 − 8 = 12. Step 4: check: 12 + 8 = 20. ✓ Answer: s = 12 stickers.

remember.en: Finish the answer: write s = 12, not 20 − 8.
remember.zh: 答案要写完：写 s = 12，不是 20 − 8。

canNow.en: I can now check a solution and solve + and − equations.
canNow.zh: 我现在会检查解，会解加减方程。

points.en: > greater than.  < less than.  The open mouth eats the BIGGER number: 7 > 3.
points.zh: > 大于；< 小于。张开的嘴吃大的数：7 > 3。

points.en: ≥ greater than OR equal to.  ≤ less than OR equal to.
points.zh: ≥ 大于或等于；≤ 小于或等于。

points.en: "at least 12" → ≥ 12 (12 or more).  "at most 30" → ≤ 30 (30 or less).
"more than 5" → > 5.  "fewer than 10" → < 10.
Example: you must be at least 12 years old to ride: a ≥ 12.
points.zh: 例子：至少 12 岁才能坐：a ≥ 12。

why.en: At most = 30 or fewer: less than or equal to.
why.zh: 最多 = 30 或更少：小于或等于。

points.en: An inequality has MANY solutions. Any number that makes it true is a solution.
points.zh: 不等式有很多解。任何让它成立的数都是解。

points.en: x > 3: 4, 5, 10 and 3.5 are solutions. 3 is NOT (3 is not greater than 3).
x ≥ 3: now 3 IS a solution too.
points.zh: x ≥ 3：现在 3 也是解。

why.en: 3 is equal to 3, not greater. For x ≥ 3 it would be a solution.
why.zh: 3 等于 3，不大于 3。如果是 x ≥ 3，3 就是解。

points.en: Draw a number line. Put an OPEN circle on 3 (3 is not included).
points.zh: 画一条数轴，在 3 上画空心圆（不包括 3）。

points.en: Draw an arrow to the RIGHT: all the bigger numbers.
points.zh: 向右画箭头：所有更大的数。

remember.en: > or < : open circle ○.  ≥ or ≤ : closed circle ●.
remember.zh: > 或 <：空心圆 ○；≥ 或 ≤：实心圆 ●。

points.en: Put a CLOSED (filled) circle on 2 (2 IS included).
points.zh: 在 2 上画实心圆（包括 2）。

points.en: Draw an arrow to the LEFT: all the smaller numbers.
points.zh: 向左画箭头：所有更小的数。

options: an open circle and an arrow to the right
a closed circle and an arrow to the left

why.en: ≤ includes 2 (closed circle) and goes to smaller numbers (left).
why.zh: ≤ 包括 2（实心圆），往小的数走（向左）。

points.en: Draw 4 number lines from 0 to 10.
points.zh: 画 4 条从 0 到 10 的数轴。

points.en: Graph: x > 4,  x < 7,  x ≥ 2,  x ≤ 9. Think: open or closed circle? Left or right arrow?
points.zh: 画出：x > 4、x < 7、x ≥ 2、x ≤ 9。想一想：空心还是实心？向左还是向右？

prompt.en: Graph the 4 inequalities on 4 number lines.
prompt.zh: 在 4 条数轴上画出 4 个不等式。

canNow.en: I can now write, check and graph inequalities.
canNow.zh: 我现在会写、检查和画不等式。

title.zh: 变量之间的关系（第 9 章）

points.en: The independent variable is the one that changes on its own (the input). The dependent variable DEPENDS on it (the output).
points.zh: 自变量是自己变化的那个（输入）；因变量依赖它（输出）。

points.en: Example: Lily earns 50 baht for each hour she helps. Hours worked = independent. Money earned = dependent.
points.zh: 例子：Lily 每帮忙 1 小时赚 50 泰铢。工作的小时数 = 自变量；赚的钱 = 因变量。

points.en: Ask: "Which one depends on the other?" That one is the dependent variable.
points.zh: 问自己：“哪个依赖另一个？”那个就是因变量。

quick.q: Money earned depends on hours worked. Hours worked is the...

why.en: Money depends on hours, so hours is independent.
why.zh: 钱依赖小时数，所以小时数是自变量。

points.en: Table: tickets x = 1, 2, 3, 4. Cost y = 3, 6, 9, 12 dollars.
Look for the rule: each y is 3 times x. The equation is y = 3x.
points.zh: 找规律：每个 y 都是 x 的 3 倍。方程是 y = 3x。

points.en: Use it: 10 tickets → y = 3 × 10 = 30 dollars.

why.en: Each y is 4 more than x: 1 + 4 = 5, 2 + 4 = 6, 3 + 4 = 7.

points.en: Make points from the table: (1, 3), (2, 6), (3, 9), (4, 12).
The independent variable goes on the x-axis (across). The dependent variable goes on the y-axis (up).
points.zh: 自变量放在 x 轴（横）；因变量放在 y 轴（竖）。

points.en: Plot each point (across first, then up). For y = 3x the points make a straight line.
points.zh: 画每个点（先横后竖）。y = 3x 的点连成一条直线。

remember.en: Independent → x-axis. Dependent → y-axis.
remember.zh: 自变量 → x 轴；因变量 → y 轴。

points.en: Make a table for y = 2x with x = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.
Draw a grid, plot the 5 points and join them with a ruler. Label the x-axis and y-axis.
points.zh: 画方格图，画出 5 个点，用尺子连起来，标出 x 轴和 y 轴。

prompt.en: Draw the table and the graph for y = 2x.
prompt.zh: 画出 y = 2x 的表格和图。

canNow.en: I can now find the independent and dependent variables, write an equation from a table and draw its graph.
canNow.zh: 我现在能找出自变量和因变量，从表格写方程，并画出图。

title.en: Weather and climate: outfit vs wardrobe
title.zh: 天气和气候：今天的衣服 vs 整个衣柜

points.en: Weather 天气 = what the air is like TODAY: hot or cold, wet or dry, windy or calm.
points.zh: 天气 = 今天空气的样子：热还是冷、湿还是干、有风还是没风。

points.en: Climate 气候 = the usual weather of a place over MANY years.
points.zh: 气候 = 一个地方很多年来通常的天气。

points.en: Weather is your outfit today. Climate is everything in your wardrobe.
points.zh: 天气就像你今天穿的衣服。气候就像你整个衣柜。

remember.en: Weather = today. Climate = many years.
remember.zh: 天气 = 今天；气候 = 很多年。

quick.q: "It is sunny and 30 °C today." Is this weather or climate?

why.en: Today = weather. Many years = climate.
why.zh: 今天 = 天气；很多年 = 气候。

points.en: The atmosphere 大气层 is the layer of air around Earth.
points.zh: 大气层是包围地球的一层空气。

points.en: Weather happens in the lowest part, called the troposphere 对流层. Clouds, rain and wind are all here.
points.zh: 天气发生在最下面一层，叫对流层。云、雨和风都在这里。

why.en: The lowest layer of the atmosphere.
why.zh: 大气层最下面的一层。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W1.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W1 的关键词。

title.en: Air mass 气团: a giant sponge

points.en: An air mass is a HUGE body of air that has the same temperature and wetness all the way through.
points.zh: 气团是一大团空气，里面的温度和湿度都差不多。

points.en: Like a giant sponge, it soaks up the temperature and water of the place it sits over.
points.zh: 它像一块巨大的海绵，吸收它所停留地方的温度和水分。

points.en: Tropical 热带的: HOT, made near the equator where the sun shines straight down.
points.zh: 热带的：热，在赤道附近形成，太阳直射。

points.en: Polar 极地的: COLD, made near the poles over ice and snow.
points.zh: 极地的：冷，在两极附近的冰雪上形成。

points.en: Maritime 海洋的: WET, the sponge sat over the ocean, like a wet towel.
points.zh: 海洋的：湿，海绵停在海洋上，像湿毛巾。

points.en: Continental 大陆的: DRY, the sponge sat over land, like a dry towel.
points.zh: 大陆的：干，海绵停在陆地上，像干毛巾。

why.en: Maritime = the sponge sat over the ocean.
why.zh: 海洋的 = 海绵停在海洋上。

points.en: First word = WHERE the sponge sat (maritime = wet, continental = dry).
points.zh: 第一个词 = 海绵停在哪里（maritime = 湿，continental = 干）。

points.en: Second word = HOW WARM (tropical = hot, polar = cold).
points.zh: 第二个词 = 有多暖（tropical = 热，polar = 冷）。

points.en: Maritime polar = wet + cold.
points.zh: Maritime polar（海洋极地气团）= 湿 + 冷。

main.zh: 海洋的 + 极地的 = 湿 + 冷

points.en: Maritime tropical: warm and wet (over the ocean near the equator).
points.zh: 海洋热带气团：暖、湿（在赤道附近的海洋上）。

points.en: Maritime polar: cool and wet (over cold northern oceans).
points.zh: 海洋极地气团：凉、湿（在北边寒冷的海洋上）。

points.en: Continental tropical: hot and dry (over hot land).
points.zh: 大陆热带气团：热、干（在炎热的陆地上）。

points.en: Continental polar: cold and dry (over cold land, in winter).
points.zh: 大陆极地气团：冷、干（冬天在寒冷的陆地上）。

why.en: Continental = dry (land). Polar = cold.
why.zh: 大陆的 = 干；极地的 = 冷。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W2.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W2 的关键词。

points.en: Cold air is HEAVY and sinks, like the cold air that falls on your feet when you open the freezer.
points.zh: 冷空气重，会下沉，就像打开冰箱冷冻室时落到脚上的冷气。

points.en: Warm air is LIGHT and rises, like a hot air balloon.
points.zh: 暖空气轻，会上升，就像热气球。

why.en: Cold air is heavy, so it sinks.
why.zh: 冷空气重，所以下沉。

title.en: Front 锋: where two air masses meet
title.zh: 锋：两种气团相遇的地方

points.en: A front is the leading edge (the front line) of a moving air mass.
points.zh: 锋是移动气团最前面的边。

points.en: When two different air masses meet, the weather changes. There are 4 kinds of front.
points.zh: 两种不同的气团相遇，天气就会变化。锋有 4 种。

title.en: Cold front 冷锋: the bulldozer

points.en: Heavy cold air pushes UNDER the warm air and shoves it up FAST and STEEP, like a bulldozer.
points.zh: 重的冷空气钻到暖空气下面，把它又快又陡地推上去，像推土机。

points.en: Result: tall storm clouds, short heavy rain or thunderstorms, then cooler, clear weather.
points.zh: 结果：高高的积雨云，短时大雨或雷暴，然后天气变凉、变晴。

points.en: Map symbol: a line with blue triangles.
points.zh: 天气图符号：带蓝色三角形的线。

remember.en: Cold front = bulldozer = sudden storms.
remember.zh: 冷锋 = 推土机 = 突然的暴风雨。

why.en: The bulldozer shoves warm air up fast: tall storm clouds.
why.zh: 推土机把暖空气快速推上去：高高的雷暴云。

title.en: Warm front 暖锋: the ramp

points.en: Light warm air slides SLOWLY up over the cold air, like walking up a gentle ramp.
points.zh: 轻的暖空气慢慢滑到冷空气上面，像走上一个缓缓的斜坡。

points.en: Result: flat grey layers of cloud, gentle rain for a long time, then warmer, more humid weather.
points.zh: 结果：平平的灰色云层，长时间的小雨，然后变暖、更潮湿。

points.en: Map symbol: a line with red half circles.
points.zh: 天气图符号：带红色半圆的线。

remember.en: Warm front = ramp = gentle rain all day.
remember.zh: 暖锋 = 斜坡 = 一整天小雨。

options: gentle rain for a long time

why.en: The ramp: warm air slides up slowly.
why.zh: 斜坡：暖空气慢慢滑上去。

points.en: Occluded front 锢囚锋: a fast runner (cold front) catches a slow walker (warm front) and lifts the warm air right off the ground. Usually light rain.
points.zh: 锢囚锋：跑得快的人（冷锋）追上走得慢的人（暖锋），把暖空气整个抬离地面。通常是小雨。

points.en: Stationary front 静止锋: a tug of war where nobody wins, so the same rainy weather stays for days.
points.zh: 静止锋：拔河谁也拉不动，所以同样的雨天会持续好几天。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W3.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W3 的关键词。

title.en: The cold drink trick: condensation 凝结

points.en: Water vapour 水蒸气 is water as an invisible gas in the air.
points.zh: 水蒸气是空气里看不见的气态的水。

points.en: On a hot day, water drops appear on a cold drink. The air touching the glass cools, and the water vapour turns back into liquid drops.
points.zh: 热天，冰饮料外面会出现小水珠。碰到杯子的空气变冷，水蒸气变回小水滴。

points.en: Turning from gas into liquid is called condensation.
points.zh: 从气体变回液体叫凝结。

items.zh: 气体 → 液体 = 凝结

quick.q: Water drops on the outside of a cold drink come from...

why.en: Vapour in the air cools on the glass and condenses.
why.zh: 空气里的水蒸气碰到冷杯子凝结。

points.en: Step 1: Warm, wet air rises.
points.zh: 第一步：暖湿空气上升。

points.en: Step 2: High up, the sky is very cold, so the air cools quickly.
points.zh: 第二步：高空很冷，空气很快变冷。

points.en: Step 3: Like drops on a cold drink, the water vapour turns into tiny drops. Millions of drops = a cloud.
points.zh: 第三步：像冰饮料外的水珠，水蒸气变成小水滴。数百万个水滴 = 一朵云。

points.en: Precipitation = any water that falls from clouds: rain, snow, sleet or hail.
points.zh: 降水 = 从云里落下来的水：雨、雪、雨夹雪或冰雹。

points.en: Drops join together and grow. When they are too heavy, they fall.
points.zh: 小水滴合在一起变大，太重了就落下来。

points.en: Cirrus 卷云: high, wispy, feathery clouds made of ice crystals.
points.zh: 卷云：很高、细细的像羽毛，由冰晶组成。

points.en: Cumulus 积云: puffy, cotton-ball clouds; fair weather.
points.zh: 积云：蓬松像棉花团，好天气。

points.en: Stratus 层云: low, flat grey sheets; an overcast (cloudy all over) day.
points.zh: 层云：低低的灰色平层，阴天。

points.en: Nimbo- or -nimbus = a rain cloud. Cumulonimbus 积雨云 = a tall thunderstorm cloud. Alto- = middle height.
points.zh: nimbo- 或 -nimbus = 下雨的云。积雨云 = 高大的雷暴云。alto- = 中等高度。

why.en: Cumulus = puffy. Stratus = flat grey sheets.
why.zh: 积云 = 蓬松；层云 = 平平的灰色层。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W4.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W4 的关键词。

points.en: Air pressure = how hard the air pushes down on Earth.
points.zh: 气压 = 空气往下压地面的力量。

points.en: High pressure 高压: heavy cold air sinks and presses down. Usually clear, sunny skies.
points.zh: 高压：重的冷空气下沉往下压。通常晴天。

points.en: Low pressure 低压: light warm air rises. Usually clouds and rain.
points.zh: 低压：轻的暖空气上升。通常多云下雨。

why.en: Sinking air: clear and sunny.
why.zh: 下沉气流：晴朗。

title.en: Wind 风: from high to low

points.en: Wind blows from HIGH pressure to LOW pressure, like air rushing out of a squeezed balloon.
points.zh: 风从高压吹向低压，就像空气从被挤的气球里冲出来。

why.en: Like air rushing out of a squeezed balloon.
why.zh: 就像空气从被挤的气球里冲出来。

points.en: Isobars are lines on a weather map that join places with the SAME air pressure.
points.zh: 等压线是天气图上把气压相同的地方连起来的线。

points.en: Lines close together = strong wind. Like lines on a hill map: close lines = steep = fast.
points.zh: 线挨得近 = 风大。像山的地图：线近 = 陡 = 快。

points.en: Lines far apart = gentle wind.
points.zh: 线离得远 = 风小。

remember.en: Isobar = same pressure line.
remember.zh: 等压线 = 气压相同的线。

why.en: Close lines = steep = fast wind.
why.zh: 线近 = 陡 = 风大。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W5.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W5 的关键词。

title.en: Station model 气象站模型: a weather selfie

points.en: A weather station measures the weather at one place.
points.zh: 气象站测量一个地方的天气。

points.en: A station model draws all its data as ONE small symbol, like a weather selfie of that place.
points.zh: 气象站模型把所有数据画成一个小符号，就像这个地方的天气自拍。

points.en: Circle in the middle: how much of the sky is covered by cloud (cloud cover 云量). More shaded = more cloud.
points.zh: 中间的圆：天空被云遮住多少（云量）。涂得越多 = 云越多。

points.en: Number on the left: temperature (°F/°C).
points.zh: 左边的数字：温度。

points.en: Number on the right: air pressure (mb).
points.zh: 右边的数字：气压（毫巴）。

points.en: The line (stick) shows wind direction. The feathers show wind speed.
points.zh: 线（杆）表示风向，上面的“羽毛”表示风速。

quick.q: On a station model, the circle shows...

why.en: More shading = more cloud.
why.zh: 涂得越多 = 云越多。

title.en: Weather map 天气图: the group photo

points.en: A weather map puts many station models together, like a big group photo of all the selfies.
points.zh: 天气图把很多气象站模型放在一起，就像所有自拍拼成一张大合照。

points.en: It also shows H and L (high and low pressure), fronts, isobars and areas of precipitation.
points.zh: 上面还有 H 和 L（高压和低压）、锋、等压线和降水区。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W6.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W6 的关键词。

title.en: Humidity 湿度 and relative humidity 相对湿度

points.en: Humidity = how much water vapour is in the air.
points.zh: 湿度 = 空气里有多少水蒸气。

points.en: Relative humidity = how FULL the air is of water vapour, as a percent (%). Like how full a sponge is.
points.zh: 相对湿度 = 空气装了多满的水蒸气，用百分比表示。就像海绵吸了多满的水。

points.en: 100% = completely full, so water starts to come out: rain or dew.
points.zh: 100% = 完全满了，水就开始出来：下雨或结露。

quick.q: Relative humidity 100% means the air is...

why.en: Full sponge: water starts to come out.
why.zh: 海绵满了：水开始出来。

title.en: Dew 露水 and dew point 露点

points.en: Dew = water drops on grass in the early morning. It is water vapour that condensed on a cool surface.
points.zh: 露水 = 清晨草上的小水珠，是水蒸气在凉的表面上凝结成的。

points.en: Dew point = the temperature where the air is full and water vapour starts turning into drops.
points.zh: 露点 = 空气装满、水蒸气开始变成水滴时的温度。

points.en: The bottom of a cloud is the height where the air has cooled to its dew point.
points.zh: 云底就是空气冷到露点的高度。

items.en: same as the cold drink trick!

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W7.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W7 的关键词。

points.en: Latitude = how far north or south of the equator a place is, in degrees (°).
points.zh: 纬度 = 一个地方离赤道往北或往南多远，用度 (°) 表示。

points.en: Near the equator (0°) the sun shines straight down: hot. Near the poles (90°) the sun is low: cold.
points.zh: 靠近赤道（0°）太阳直射：热。靠近两极（90°）太阳斜照：冷。

points.en: Water warms up and cools down much more SLOWLY than land.
points.zh: 水变热、变冷都比陆地慢得多。

points.en: So places on the coast have milder (gentler) weather. San Diego (by the ocean): summer 24°C, winter 9°C.
points.zh: 所以海边的地方天气更温和。圣地亚哥（海边）：夏天 24°C，冬天 9°C。

points.en: Places far inland change more. Phoenix (inland): summer 41°C, winter 5°C.
points.zh: 离海远的内陆地方变化更大。凤凰城（内陆）：夏天 41°C，冬天 5°C。

quick.q: Which city has the smaller temperature change?

why.en: San Diego: 9 °C to 24 °C = 15 °C change. Phoenix: 5 °C to 41 °C = 36 °C change.
why.zh: 圣地亚哥：9 °C 到 24 °C，相差 15 °C；凤凰城：5 °C 到 41 °C，相差 36 °C。

title.en: Climate factors 3: mountains and rain shadow 雨影区

points.en: A mountain is like a wall. Wet air climbs up one side, cools, and drops its rain there.
points.zh: 山像一堵墙。湿空气爬上一边，变冷，就在那边下雨。

points.en: The other side gets dry air and very little rain. This dry side is the rain shadow.
points.zh: 另一边只剩干空气，几乎不下雨。这个干的一边叫雨影区。

quick.q: The dry side of a mountain is the...

why.en: The rain falls on the other side.
why.zh: 雨都下在另一边了。

title.en: Climate factors 4: global winds 全球风带

points.en: Global winds blow steadily in the same direction over large parts of Earth.
points.zh: 全球风带在地球的大片地方一直朝同一个方向吹。

points.en: Winds from a warm sea carry warm, wet air over the land.
points.zh: 从温暖海洋吹来的风，把暖湿空气带到陆地上。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W8.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W8 的关键词。

points.en: Equator 赤道 0°. Tropic of Cancer 北回归线 23.5°N. Tropic of Capricorn 南回归线 23.5°S.
points.zh: 赤道 0°。北回归线 23.5°N。南回归线 23.5°S。

points.en: Arctic Circle 北极圈 66.5°N. Antarctic Circle 南极圈 66.5°S.
points.zh: 北极圈 66.5°N。南极圈 66.5°S。

why.en: Equator 0°. Tropics 23.5°. Polar circles 66.5°.

title.zh: 3 个气候带：地球衣柜的抽屉

points.en: Tropical 热带: between the two tropics. Warm and wet.
points.zh: 热带：在两条回归线之间。温暖潮湿。

points.en: Temperate 温带: between the tropics and the polar circles. Moderate (not too hot, not too cold).
points.zh: 温带：在回归线和极圈之间。温和（不太热也不太冷）。

points.en: Polar 极地: inside the Arctic and Antarctic Circles. Cold and dry.
points.zh: 极地：在北极圈和南极圈里面。寒冷干燥。

quick.q: The zone between the two tropics is...

why.en: Between 23.5°N and 23.5°S: tropical, warm and wet.
why.zh: 在北纬 23.5° 和南纬 23.5° 之间：热带，温暖潮湿。

points.en: Tropical: hot all year and often very wet, near the equator.
points.zh: 热带气候：一年都热，常常很湿，在赤道附近。

points.en: Dry: very little rain, such as deserts.
points.zh: 干旱气候：雨很少，比如沙漠。

points.en: Temperate: mild, with warm summers and cool winters.
points.zh: 温带气候：温和，夏天暖，冬天凉。

points.en: Continental: hot summers and very cold winters, far from the sea.
points.zh: 大陆性气候：夏天热，冬天很冷，离海远。

points.en: Polar: freezing cold all year, near the poles.
points.zh: 极地气候：一年都很冷，在两极附近。

why.en: Very little rain = dry climate.
why.zh: 雨很少 = 干旱气候。

points.en: A biome is a big area with its own climate, plants and animals.
points.zh: 生物群系是一大片有自己的气候、植物和动物的地区。

points.en: Biomes: polar ice, tundra 苔原, coniferous forest 针叶林, deciduous forest 落叶林, grassland 草原, savanna 稀树草原, chaparral, desert 沙漠, tropical rain forest 热带雨林, mountains.
points.zh: 生物群系：极地冰原、苔原、针叶林、落叶林、草原、稀树草原、灌木丛、沙漠、热带雨林、山地。

canNow.en: I can now explain the key words in W9.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释 W9 的关键词。

points.en: The atmosphere is the blanket of air around Earth. Gravity holds it in place.
points.zh: 大气层是包围地球的一层空气，重力把它留在地球周围。

points.en: It gives us air to breathe, keeps Earth warm, and blocks harmful rays from the Sun.
points.zh: 它给我们呼吸的空气，让地球保持温暖，还挡住太阳的有害光线。

points.en: Nitrogen: about 78%. This is the MOST common gas.
points.zh: 氮气：大约 78%，是最多的气体。

points.en: Oxygen: about 21%. We need it to breathe.
points.zh: 氧气：大约 21%，我们呼吸需要它。

points.en: The last 1%: mostly argon, plus a little carbon dioxide (about 0.04%) and other gases.
points.zh: 最后的 1%：主要是氩气，还有一点二氧化碳（大约 0.04%）和其他气体。

points.en: Water vapour is also in the air. Its amount changes from day to day.
points.zh: 空气里还有水蒸气，它的多少每天都在变。

remember.en: Nitrogen 78, oxygen 21, others 1.

quick.q: Which gas is MOST of the air?

why.en: Nitrogen is about 78%. Oxygen is about 21%.
why.zh: 氮气大约 78%，氧气大约 21%。

title.en: The 5 layers, from the ground up

points.en: 1. Troposphere: from the ground to about 12 km. ALL weather happens here. It gets colder as you go up.
points.zh: 1. 对流层：从地面到大约 12 千米。所有天气都在这里。越往上越冷。

points.en: 2. Stratosphere: about 12 to 50 km. The OZONE LAYER is here: it absorbs harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays.
points.zh: 2. 平流层：大约 12 到 50 千米。臭氧层在这里，它吸收有害的紫外线。

points.en: 3. Mesosphere: about 50 to 85 km. The coldest layer. Meteors burn up here (shooting stars).
points.zh: 3. 中间层：大约 50 到 85 千米。最冷的一层。流星在这里烧掉。

points.en: 4. Thermosphere: about 85 to 600 km. Very hot. The northern lights (auroras) happen here.
points.zh: 4. 热层：大约 85 到 600 千米。非常热。极光在这里出现。

points.en: 5. Exosphere: the outer edge. The air fades into space. Many satellites orbit here.
points.zh: 5. 外逸层：最外面一层，空气慢慢消失到太空里。很多卫星在这里运行。

remember.en: Order from the ground: Troposphere, Stratosphere, Mesosphere, Thermosphere, Exosphere. "The Strong Man Throws Eggs."
remember.zh: 从地面往上：对流层、平流层、中间层、热层、外逸层。记法：The Strong Man Throws Eggs。

why.en: The troposphere is the lowest layer, where clouds, rain and wind are.
why.zh: 对流层是最低的一层，云、雨和风都在这里。

points.en: Ozone is a gas in the stratosphere.
points.zh: 臭氧是平流层里的一种气体。

points.en: It absorbs most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays, which can burn skin and damage eyes.
points.zh: 它吸收大部分太阳的有害紫外线，紫外线会晒伤皮肤、伤害眼睛。

quick.q: The ozone layer is in the...

why.en: Ozone is in the stratosphere, layer 2.
why.zh: 臭氧在平流层，第 2 层。

title.en: Draw it: the layers of the atmosphere

points.en: Draw the ground at the bottom of the page. Draw 5 layers above it, one on top of the other.
points.zh: 在纸的最下面画地面，上面一层一层画 5 层。

points.en: Label each layer and draw one thing in it: a cloud, the ozone layer, a meteor, an aurora, a satellite.
points.zh: 给每层写名字，并在每层画一样东西：云、臭氧层、流星、极光、卫星。

prompt.en: Draw and label the 5 layers of the atmosphere.
prompt.zh: 画出大气层的 5 层并写上名字。

canNow.en: I can now name the gases in air and the 5 layers of the atmosphere.
canNow.zh: 我现在能说出空气里的气体和大气层的 5 层。

points.en: Temperature = how hot or cold the air is.
points.zh: 温度 = 空气有多热或多冷。

points.en: Unit: degrees Celsius (°C) or degrees Fahrenheit (°F).
points.zh: 单位：摄氏度 (°C) 或华氏度 (°F)。

points.en: Tool: a thermometer. Water freezes at 0 °C (32 °F) and boils at 100 °C (212 °F).
points.zh: 仪器：温度计。水在 0 °C（32 °F）结冰，在 100 °C（212 °F）沸腾。

points.en: Air pressure = the weight of the air pushing down on Earth.
points.zh: 气压 = 空气压在地面上的重量。

points.en: Unit: millibars (mb) or hectopascals (hPa). 1 mb = 1 hPa. Normal air pressure at sea level is about 1013 mb.
points.zh: 单位：毫巴 (mb) 或百帕 (hPa)。1 毫巴 = 1 百帕。海平面的正常气压大约是 1013 毫巴。

points.en: Tool: a barometer.
points.zh: 仪器：气压计。

points.en: Falling pressure often means clouds and storms. Rising pressure often means clear weather.
points.zh: 气压下降常常表示有云和暴风雨；气压上升常常表示天气晴朗。

why.en: Barometer = air pressure. Thermometer = temperature.
why.zh: 气压计 = 气压；温度计 = 温度。

points.en: Wind speed = how fast the air is moving.
points.zh: 风速 = 空气移动得有多快。

points.en: Unit: kilometres per hour (km/h), metres per second (m/s), miles per hour (mph) or knots.
points.zh: 单位：千米每小时 (km/h)、米每秒 (m/s)、英里每小时 (mph) 或节。

points.en: Tool: an anemometer. Its cups catch the wind and spin. Faster spinning = faster wind.
points.zh: 仪器：风速计。它的小杯子接住风并转动，转得越快，风越快。

why.en: Anemometer = speed. Wind vane = direction.
why.zh: 风速计 = 风速；风向标 = 风向。

points.en: Wind direction = where the wind is coming FROM.
points.zh: 风向 = 风从哪里吹来。

points.en: Tool: a wind vane (weather vane). Its arrow points INTO the wind. A windsock also shows the direction.
points.zh: 仪器：风向标。它的箭头指向风吹来的方向。风向袋也能显示风向。

points.en: A north wind blows FROM the north, towards the south.
points.zh: 北风是从北边吹来的，吹向南边。

points.en: Unit: compass directions (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW).
points.zh: 单位：方向（北、东北、东、东南、南、西南、西、西北）。

remember.en: A wind is named by where it comes FROM.
remember.zh: 风的名字看它从哪里吹来。

why.en: Winds are named by where they come FROM.
why.zh: 风的名字看它从哪里吹来。

points.en: Humidity = the amount of water vapour in the air.
points.zh: 湿度 = 空气里水蒸气的多少。

points.en: Unit: relative humidity, as a percent (%). 100% = the air is full of water vapour.
points.zh: 单位：相对湿度，用百分比 (%) 表示。100% = 空气里的水蒸气满了。

points.en: Tool: a hygrometer. A psychrometer is a hygrometer with two thermometers (one wet, one dry).
points.zh: 仪器：湿度计。干湿球湿度计是用两个温度计（一个湿、一个干）的湿度计。

why.en: Hygro = water. A hygrometer measures humidity.
why.zh: hygro = 水。湿度计测量湿度。

points.en: Temperature: thermometer, °C or °F.
points.zh: 温度：温度计，°C 或 °F。

points.en: Air pressure: barometer, millibars (mb) or hectopascals (hPa).
points.zh: 气压：气压计，毫巴或百帕。

points.en: Wind speed: anemometer, km/h. Wind direction: wind vane, compass directions.
points.zh: 风速：风速计，千米每小时。风向：风向标，方向。

points.en: Humidity: hygrometer, %.
points.zh: 湿度：湿度计，%。

points.en: Extra: rain is measured with a rain gauge, in millimetres (mm).
points.zh: 另外：雨量用雨量计测量，单位是毫米 (mm)。

items.zh: 风速：风速计，千米每小时

points.en: Draw a small weather station with 4 tools: a thermometer, a barometer, an anemometer (spinning cups) and a wind vane.
points.zh: 画一个小气象站，有 4 种仪器：温度计、气压计、风速计（转动的小杯子）和风向标。

points.en: Under each tool, write what it measures and its unit.
points.zh: 在每个仪器下面写它测量什么和它的单位。

prompt.en: Draw 4 weather tools and label what each measures.
prompt.zh: 画 4 种天气仪器，写出每种测量什么。

canNow.en: I can now name the tool and the unit for temperature, air pressure, wind and humidity.
canNow.zh: 我现在能说出温度、气压、风和湿度的仪器和单位。

title.en: Heat moves from hot to cold
title.zh: 热从热的地方传到冷的地方

points.en: Heat always moves from something hotter to something colder.
points.zh: 热总是从比较热的东西传到比较冷的东西。

points.en: There are 3 ways: conduction, convection and radiation.
points.zh: 有 3 种方式：传导、对流和辐射。

points.en: Conduction = heat moving by TOUCHING. Particles bump into the particles next to them.
points.zh: 传导 = 通过接触传热。粒子撞到旁边的粒子。

points.en: Examples: a metal spoon in hot soup gets hot. Hot sand burns your feet.
points.zh: 例子：放在热汤里的金属勺子会变热；热沙子烫脚。

points.en: In weather: the ground warms the air that touches it.
points.zh: 在天气里：地面把接触它的空气加热。

quick.q: A metal spoon in hot soup gets hot. This is...

why.en: The spoon TOUCHES the hot soup: conduction.
why.zh: 勺子接触热汤：传导。

points.en: Convection = heat moving in liquids and gases as they flow. Warm air or water RISES, cool air or water SINKS.
points.zh: 对流 = 液体和气体流动时传热。热的空气或水上升，冷的下沉。

points.en: This makes a loop called a convection current.
points.zh: 这样形成一个循环，叫对流。

points.en: Examples: water moving in a boiling pot. Warm air rising to make clouds and wind.
points.zh: 例子：锅里沸腾的水在流动；热空气上升形成云和风。

quick.q: Warm air rising and cool air sinking is...

why.en: Moving air or water in a loop: convection.
why.zh: 空气或水循环流动：对流。

points.en: Radiation = heat moving as rays (waves). It can travel through empty space, with no touching.
points.zh: 辐射 = 热以光线（波）的形式传递，可以穿过太空，不用接触。

points.en: Examples: the Sun warms Earth. You feel warm in front of a campfire.
points.zh: 例子：太阳让地球变暖；坐在篝火前会觉得暖。

why.en: There is empty space between the Sun and Earth, so only rays can carry the heat.
why.zh: 太阳和地球之间是太空，只能靠光线传热。

title.en: Draw it: a pot on a stove

points.en: Draw a pot of water on a stove, with the Sun shining through a window.
points.zh: 画炉子上的一锅水，阳光从窗户照进来。

points.en: Draw and label: the hot pot handle (conduction), arrows in a loop in the water (convection), the Sun's rays (radiation).
points.zh: 画出并标出：烫手的锅柄（传导）、水里循环的箭头（对流）、太阳的光线（辐射）。

remember.en: Touch = conduction. Current = convection. Rays = radiation.
remember.zh: 接触 = 传导；流动 = 对流；光线 = 辐射。

prompt.en: Draw one picture that shows all 3 kinds of heat transfer. Label each.
prompt.zh: 画一幅图表示 3 种热传递，并写上标签。

canNow.en: I can now explain conduction, convection and radiation with an example of each.
canNow.zh: 我现在能用例子解释传导、对流和辐射。

points.en: The Sun heats Earth unevenly. The equator gets the most direct sunlight, the poles the least.
points.zh: 太阳给地球加热不均匀。赤道得到的阳光最直接，两极最少。

points.en: Warm air at the equator rises. Cold air at the poles sinks. Air moves to fill the gaps: that moving air is wind.
points.zh: 赤道的热空气上升，两极的冷空气下沉。空气流动去填补空位，流动的空气就是风。

steps.en: warm air rises at the equator
cold air sinks at the poles

points.en: Earth spins, so winds do not blow in straight lines. They curve.
points.zh: 地球在自转，所以风不是直线吹，而是会弯。

points.en: In the Northern Hemisphere winds curve to the RIGHT. In the Southern Hemisphere they curve to the LEFT.
points.zh: 北半球的风向右弯，南半球的风向左弯。

why.en: Earth's spinning bends the winds: the Coriolis effect.
why.zh: 地球自转让风弯曲：科里奥利效应。

points.en: Trade winds: between the equator and 30°. They blow from the east towards the equator.
points.zh: 信风：在赤道和 30° 之间，从东边吹向赤道。

points.en: Westerlies: between 30° and 60°. They blow from the west and carry weather from west to east.
points.zh: 西风带：在 30° 和 60° 之间，从西边吹来，把天气从西带到东。

points.en: Polar easterlies: between 60° and the poles. They blow from the east and are very cold.
points.zh: 极地东风：在 60° 和两极之间，从东边吹来，非常冷。

points.en: Near the equator there is a calm area called the doldrums.
points.zh: 赤道附近有一片风很小的地方，叫赤道无风带。

items.en: trade winds: 0° to 30°, from the east
items.zh: 信风：0° 到 30°，从东边吹来
西风带：30° 到 60°，从西边吹来

items.en: polar easterlies: 60° to 90°, from the east
items.zh: 极地东风：60° 到 90°，从东边吹来

why.en: Trade winds 0 to 30, westerlies 30 to 60, polar easterlies 60 to 90.
why.zh: 信风 0 到 30，西风 30 到 60，极地东风 60 到 90。

points.en: Jet streams are very fast winds high up, near the top of the troposphere.
points.zh: 急流是高空中非常快的风，在对流层顶部附近。

points.en: They blow from west to east and help steer storms. Planes flying east can use them to save fuel.
points.zh: 它们从西往东吹，能带动风暴移动。往东飞的飞机可以借助急流省油。

points.en: Day: land heats up faster than the sea. Warm air over land rises, and cool air from the sea moves in: a sea breeze.
points.zh: 白天：陆地比海水热得快。陆地上的热空气上升，海上的冷空气吹过来：海风。

points.en: Night: land cools faster. Air moves from the land out to the sea: a land breeze.
points.zh: 晚上：陆地冷得快，空气从陆地吹向海上：陆风。

remember.en: Winds are convection currents in the air.
remember.zh: 风就是空气里的对流。

points.en: Draw a big circle for Earth. Draw lines at the equator, 30°N, 60°N, 30°S and 60°S.
points.zh: 画一个大圆代表地球，在赤道、北纬 30°、北纬 60°、南纬 30°、南纬 60° 画线。

points.en: Add arrows for the trade winds, westerlies and polar easterlies, and label them.
points.zh: 画箭头表示信风、西风带和极地东风，并写上名字。

prompt.en: Draw Earth with the 3 wind belts in each half.
prompt.zh: 画地球，每个半球画 3 个风带。

canNow.en: I can now explain why wind blows and name the 3 global wind belts.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释为什么会有风，并说出 3 个全球风带。

points.en: Lightning is a giant spark of electricity, inside a storm cloud or between the cloud and the ground.
points.zh: 闪电是巨大的电火花，在雷雨云里，或者在云和地面之间。

points.en: Thunder is the sound lightning makes: it heats the air so fast that the air expands with a boom.
points.zh: 雷是闪电发出的声音：闪电让空气一下子变得很热，空气猛地膨胀，发出轰隆声。

points.en: We see lightning BEFORE we hear thunder because light travels much faster than sound.
points.zh: 我们先看到闪电，后听到雷声，因为光比声音快得多。

points.en: Count the seconds from the flash to the thunder and divide by 3: that is about how many kilometres away the storm is.
points.zh: 从看到闪电数到听到雷声，秒数除以 3，大约就是风暴离你多少千米。

remember.en: Light first, sound second.
remember.zh: 先有光，后有声。

quick.q: We see lightning before we hear thunder because...

why.en: They happen at the same time, but light reaches us first.
why.zh: 它们同时发生，但光先到达我们。

points.en: A tropical cyclone is a huge spinning storm that forms over WARM tropical ocean water.
points.zh: 热带气旋是在温暖的热带海洋上形成的巨大旋转风暴。

points.en: It has very low air pressure in the middle. Warm, wet air rises and gives it energy.
points.zh: 它中间的气压很低。温暖潮湿的空气上升，给它能量。

points.en: It has different names in different places: hurricane (Atlantic Ocean), typhoon (western Pacific, near Asia), cyclone (Indian Ocean).
points.zh: 在不同地方名字不同：飓风（大西洋）、台风（西太平洋，靠近亚洲）、气旋（印度洋）。

items.en: hurricane, typhoon, cyclone: same kind of storm
items.zh: 飓风、台风、气旋：同一类风暴

why.en: Warm ocean water gives it energy. Over land it gets weaker.
why.zh: 温暖的海水给它能量，到了陆地上就会变弱。

points.en: A hurricane is a strong tropical cyclone with winds of at least 119 km/h (74 mph).
points.zh: 飓风是很强的热带气旋，风速至少 119 千米每小时（74 英里每小时）。

points.en: The eye in the middle is calm and clear. The eye wall around it has the strongest winds and heaviest rain. Rain bands spiral outwards.
points.zh: 中间的风眼平静晴朗。风眼周围的眼墙风最大、雨最大。雨带向外旋转。

points.en: Dangers: very strong winds, heavy rain, floods and a storm surge (the sea rising onto the land).
points.zh: 危险：狂风、暴雨、洪水和风暴潮（海水涌上陆地）。

quick.q: The calm centre of a hurricane is the...

why.en: The eye is calm. The eye wall around it is the most dangerous part.
why.zh: 风眼平静，周围的眼墙最危险。

points.en: A tornado is a narrow, violently spinning column of air that reaches from a thunderstorm cloud down to the ground.
points.zh: 龙卷风是一根又细又猛烈旋转的空气柱，从雷雨云一直伸到地面。

points.en: It forms over LAND, is small (often less than 1 km wide) and usually lasts only minutes.
points.zh: 它在陆地上形成，比较小（常常不到 1 千米宽），通常只持续几分钟。

points.en: But its winds are the fastest on Earth and can destroy buildings.
points.zh: 但它的风是地球上最快的，能摧毁房子。

points.en: A funnel cloud is a spinning cloud that has not touched the ground yet.
points.zh: 漏斗云是还没碰到地面的旋转的云。

why.en: Tornadoes come down from thunderstorm clouds over land. Hurricanes form over warm oceans.
why.zh: 龙卷风从陆地上的雷雨云下来；飓风在温暖的海上形成。

points.en: Hurricane: forms over warm ocean, HUGE (hundreds of km wide), lasts days to weeks, can be tracked for days.
points.zh: 飓风：在温暖的海上形成，非常大（几百千米宽），持续几天到几周，可以提前几天追踪。

points.en: Tornado: forms over land from a thunderstorm, SMALL, lasts minutes, comes with very little warning.
points.zh: 龙卷风：在陆地上从雷雨云形成，很小，只持续几分钟，几乎没有预警。

points.en: Both spin around a centre of low air pressure.
points.zh: 两个都围着低气压的中心旋转。

items.zh: 龙卷风：陆地、很小、几分钟

title.en: Draw it: a hurricane and a tornado

points.en: Draw a hurricane seen from above: a spiral with the eye in the middle, the eye wall and rain bands.
points.zh: 从上往下画一个飓风：一个螺旋，中间是风眼，还有眼墙和雨带。

points.en: Next to it, draw a tornado: a thin funnel from a dark cloud down to the ground. Write 2 differences.
points.zh: 在旁边画一个龙卷风：从乌云伸到地面的细漏斗。写出 2 个不同点。

prompt.en: Draw a hurricane from above and a tornado from the side. Label the parts.
prompt.zh: 从上面画飓风，从侧面画龙卷风，标出各部分。

canNow.en: I can now explain lightning and thunder and tell a hurricane from a tornado.
canNow.zh: 我现在能解释闪电和雷，并分清飓风和龙卷风。

points.en: Latitude lines go AROUND Earth, side to side, like the rungs of a ladder.
points.zh: 纬线横着绕地球一圈，像梯子的横档。

points.en: They measure how far north or south of the equator a place is, from 0° to 90° N or 90° S.
points.zh: 它们表示一个地方离赤道往北或往南多远，从 0° 到北纬 90° 或南纬 90°。

remember.en: LATitude lines lie FLAT (like a ladder).
remember.zh: 纬线是平的（像梯子）。

points.en: Longitude lines go from the North Pole to the South Pole, top to bottom.
points.zh: 经线从北极连到南极，上下竖着。

points.en: They measure how far east or west of the Prime Meridian a place is, from 0° to 180° E or 180° W.
points.zh: 它们表示一个地方离本初子午线往东或往西多远，从 0° 到东经 180° 或西经 180°。

points.en: The Prime Meridian is 0° longitude. It passes through Greenwich, in London.
points.zh: 本初子午线是 0° 经线，经过伦敦的格林尼治。

why.en: Equator = 0° latitude. Prime Meridian = 0° longitude.
why.zh: 赤道 = 0° 纬线；本初子午线 = 0° 经线。

points.en: Equator: 0° latitude. It splits Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
points.zh: 赤道：0° 纬线，把地球分成北半球和南半球。

points.en: Prime Meridian: 0° longitude. It splits Earth into the Eastern and Western Hemispheres.
points.zh: 本初子午线：0° 经线，把地球分成东半球和西半球。

points.en: Tropic of Cancer: 23.5° N. Tropic of Capricorn: 23.5° S.
points.zh: 北回归线：北纬 23.5°。南回归线：南纬 23.5°。

points.en: Arctic Circle: 66.5° N. Antarctic Circle: 66.5° S.
points.zh: 北极圈：北纬 66.5°。南极圈：南纬 66.5°。

remember.en: Cancer is on top (north). Capricorn is at the bottom (south).
remember.zh: 北回归线在上面（北边），南回归线在下面（南边）。

quick.q: The Tropic of Capricorn is at...

why.en: Capricorn is south. Cancer is north.
why.zh: 南回归线在南边，北回归线在北边。

title.en: Coordinates: the address of a place

points.en: Coordinates give a place's latitude and longitude. Write LATITUDE first, then LONGITUDE.
points.zh: 坐标给出一个地方的纬度和经度。先写纬度，再写经度。

points.en: Chiang Mai is at about 19° N, 99° E: 19 degrees north of the equator and 99 degrees east of the Prime Meridian.
points.zh: 清迈大约在北纬 19°、东经 99°：在赤道以北 19 度，本初子午线以东 99 度。

points.en: To find a place: go to its latitude line, then follow it to its longitude line. Where they cross is the place.
points.zh: 找一个地方：先找到它的纬线，再沿着纬线找到它的经线，两条线相交的地方就是它。

why.en: Latitude first, then longitude: 19° N, 99° E.
why.zh: 先纬度后经度：北纬 19°，东经 99°。

points.en: On a grid, a point is written as (x, y): x is how far ACROSS, y is how far UP.
points.zh: 在方格图上，一个点写成 (x, y)：x 是往右多远，y 是往上多远。

points.en: (3, 2) means: start at (0, 0), go 3 across, then 2 up.
points.zh: (3, 2) 表示：从 (0, 0) 出发，往右 3 格，再往上 2 格。

points.en: Remember: across first, then up. "Walk along the corridor, then up the stairs."
points.zh: 记住：先横着走，再往上。“先走走廊，再上楼梯。”

why.en: The first number is across (x), the second is up (y).
why.zh: 第一个数是横的 (x)，第二个数是往上 (y)。

points.en: Draw a big circle. Draw and label the equator, the two tropics and the two polar circles (flat lines).
points.zh: 画一个大圆，画出并标出赤道、两条回归线和两个极圈（横线）。

points.en: Draw the Prime Meridian from top to bottom. Mark Chiang Mai at about 19° N, 99° E with a star.
points.zh: 从上到下画本初子午线。用星星标出清迈，大约在北纬 19°、东经 99°。

prompt.en: Draw a globe with the special lines. Label each one with its degrees.
prompt.zh: 画一个地球仪和特别的线，写上每条线的度数。

canNow.en: I can now read latitude and longitude, name the special lines and plot coordinates.
canNow.zh: 我现在能读纬度和经度，说出特别的线，并画出坐标。
